_readme: Keys are the <label> prefix used in capture_harness.sh filenames (everything before the timestamp). catalog_pcaps.py looks up each pcap's label here for metadata. Add one entry per distinct client/server you captured.

curl_cipher_restricted.name: curl
curl_cipher_restricted.notes: Forced to a small cipher list to create a distinct JA3 fingerprint and show how client stack configuration changes the handshake.

openssl_s_client.name: OpenSSL s_client
openssl_s_client.notes: OpenSSL command-line client, useful for comparing command-line TLS stacks to curl and browser traffic.

curl_test2.name: curl
curl_test2.notes: Old curl test pcap retained for continuity in the seed database.

curl_test3.name: curl
curl_test3.notes: Old curl test pcap retained for continuity in the seed database.

chrome_headless_playwright.name: Chrome
chrome_headless_playwright.notes: Capture with default browser TLS stack through Playwright. Good for comparison with curl and custom clients.

firefox_headless_playwright.name: Firefox
firefox_headless_playwright.notes: Capture with Firefox via Playwright. Useful for browser-family distinction.

edge_headless_playwright.name: Edge
edge_headless_playwright.notes: Optional verification if Edge is available in the environment.

brave_headless.name: Brave
brave_headless.notes: Useful for distinguishing modern Chromium variants.

curl_impersonate_firefox.name: curl-impersonate (Firefox mimic)
curl_impersonate_firefox.notes: Mimics Firefox JA3/JA4; ideal for evasion discussion.

node_https_default.name: Node.js https
node_https_default.notes: Node's built-in https module. Capture as a baseline for JS TLS behavior.

go_net_http.name: Go net/http
go_net_http.notes: Go's standard library TLS fingerprint is distinct from browsers and curl.

java_https_urlconnection.name: Java HttpsURLConnection
java_https_urlconnection.notes: Java default TLS stack is a useful library baseline.

sslyze_scan.name: SSLyze
sslyze_scan.notes: Tooling client used to probe servers; good for legitimate scanner examples.

testssl_sh_scan.name: testssl.sh
testssl_sh_scan.notes: Script-based TLS scanner; useful for comparison with browsers and curl.

nmap_ssl_enum_ciphers.name: nmap --script ssl-enum-ciphers
nmap_ssl_enum_ciphers.notes: Another valid TLS scanner fingerprint for the database.

public_malware_reference.name: Malware reference traffic
public_malware_reference.notes: Use labeled public malware PCAPs only; do not execute malware locally.
